title: FBI Agent’s Dad Thinks He’s Above The Law
description:
On August 24th, 2022, officers were dispatched in reference to a car accident. What seemed to be a simple encounter at first, started escalating soon. The police tracked the man to his house which threw him off guard. He drove off at first but later, took a U-turn and came back. The man was taken to the jail where he became very uncooperative and challenging to deal with. Later, the police got him a cab and released him on a D-bond. He was charged with DUI, obstructing identification, resisting arrest, leaving the scene of an accident and assault. 

Watch another video - When your parents are forced to call the cops on you: https://youtu.be/g6nfCFuGJ-0

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Secrets provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
